listenings.text: Good morning, everybody. We are starting now. Marina is connecting, and we are still waiting for the German team. Ana is listening, but her camera is not working today, so please do not look for her on the screen. In a moment Marina is presenting the report about small schools, and after that we are discussing the data together. If you are joining from another country, please write your city in the chat. Thank you, and welcome.

Hi, this is a quick message from the office. I am writing because two people are waiting for an answer about the November event. We are preparing the list of rooms this week, and we are sending it on Friday. I am not working tomorrow, so if you need anything, write to the coordinator. He is answering all the messages today. Thank you very much, and have a good week.

extra_audio.text: Joice is opening the meeting on her computer. She is writing her city in the chat. She is listening to the presentation about small schools. She is asking a question about the platform. She is closing the call and writing two notes.

lesson.grammar_point: present continuous for actions happening now
